title: Editor E0 task 12b, a Space email draft loads as nodes behind render_path_email
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. loadSpaceEmailDraft returns nodeLayout (a stored node document as it is, a legacy one upgraded in memory) only while render_path_email is on, so the Space composers, which already mount the canvas pane, run the node editor and save through saveSpaceEmailDraft (prepareEmailLayoutWrite decides storage). Switch off: no change. Next: nurture saves, step-block-editor, the member side.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/email-drafts.ts','utf8');if(!s.includes(\"renderPathEnabled('email')\")||!s.includes('nodeLayout')){console.error('LIVE-1060: Space draft load does not serve nodes behind render_path_email');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Space draft load serves nodes without the switch or stops serving them.
